about: Skins whose own 18+ look (assets/art/heroes/<hero>/skins/<art>/adult/) is current: painted from the skin's present art and reviewed. In 18+ mode such a skin shows that look (HeroArt._built_art); every other skin shows the heroine's nude base look. The art session adds "<hero>@<art>" here as it installs and reviews each one. The 60 folders from 2026-10-19 predate the skins' re-render (2026-10-21/22) and stay out.
